messages:
noah: quick sweep request — can someone glance at the Model Activity compact rail + export modal for keyboard traps and SR labels? noticed focus sometimes disappears when closing modal with ESC. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-compact-rail :mag:

jeni: looked at it. Tab order is mostly fine but when export modal opens focus lands on tiny close icon instead of primary CTA. recommend moving initial focus to the dialog container and then to the primary button.

omar: also missing dialog semantics — add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing to modal heading. No accessible name today.

katie: visual: CSV/JSON toggle focus ring is too subtle in high-contrast mode. propose :focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #004E8C; } and increase thumb/track contrast to >=3.5:1.

jeni: ensure ESC handler removes focus trap before hiding so SR doesn't get stuck; also set inert or aria-hidden on background content while open.

omar: export success toast should include a link to the artifact; use aria-live="polite" and give the link role="link" with an id. make toast tabindex=-1 so screen readers can jump.

a11y-lint-bot: Automated results: missing role="dialog" (FAIL), focus-restore after close goes to body (FAIL), toggle contrast borderline (WARN), SVGs missing <title> (WARN).

joeni: for focus restore save opener element before open and restore if present; fallback focus to next logical control in rail. Add aria-describedby to modal for brief export details (rows, size).

noah: added checklist to PR: dialog semantics, focus trap, focus restore, toast link, SVG title tags, toggle contrast tweaks. opening branch now — will tag for SR pass after fixes. thanks!
